events.actor: Judge Jerónimo Alonso Herrero / Juzgado de Instrucción nº2 de Arrecife
events.event: Formal exhorto directed to Juzgado de lo Mercantil nº1 in relation to Concurso 36/2012; a separate allegation component concerning the Mercantile organ is routed toward the Las Palmas Decanato.
events.proves: a formal court-to-court communication lane existed
events.does_not_prove: the truth of the allegations or criminal responsibility

events.event: Same-day criminal amplification alleges forced access/entry, lock and access-control interference and requests urgent protection after the alleged hotel seizure/takeover.
events.proves: the allegation and protection request were contemporaneously articulated
events.does_not_prove: that a seizure, offence or unlawful possession was adjudicated

events.event: Takeover/criminal dossier circulates toward the insolvency administrator and legal advisers through multiple notice channels.
Controlled communication evidence records direct contact with the insolvency administrator concerning the new security/CAM presence.
events.does_not_prove: the administrator's complete knowledge, response, motive or liability

events.event: Conclusion route/intention associated with historically applicable former LC Article 176.
events.user_declaration: Gil Marer states that later conduct frustrated further action on the conclusion route.
events.boundary: Later TRLC Article 465.6 numbering must not be retroactively applied to June 2018.

events.event: Arrecife receives a response from Mercantile Court nº1 to the earlier exhorto.
events.boundary: Do not state that Mercantil never responded.

events.event: Arrecife Auto records that the received reply is joined to DP 1132/2018.
Contemporaneous material records a meeting with the Mercantile judge and insolvency administrator after Irigoyen had received/read takeover-criminal materials.
Client asks who will present/communicate the Arrecife Auto to Mercantil; the response says it should be communicated and that an escrito had already been drafted.
events.boundary: A located draft does not prove filing or non-filing; absence of a located receipt does not prove no filing existed.
